You said filters stay active across workspace switches and sometimes hide rows in the new workspace. What should the new setting control on a workspace change?
A) A reset-filters-on-switch toggle that defaults to on, so switching clears filters unless a user opts to keep them
B) The same toggle defaulting to off, so current behavior is unchanged until a user enables reset

Recommendation: A - defaulting to reset fixes the hidden-rows problem for everyone, and users who rely on carried filters can still turn it off.
